verdict.rationale: Stagehand's own observability docs say Browserbase sessions get real-time visibility through a session dashboard with live screen recording and replay, which covers the 'watch a session live' half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows a human taking control of a running session. Attaching over CDP to a browser you are already running is a building block, not a takeover feature, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented human takeover or interactive control mid-run, a pause/resume handoff between agent and human, and independent or hands-on corroboration of live viewing.
